name: Chuck McKeldin
personality: Described as a speedy little fellow
childhood_experience: Went with Barbara to the circus when he was six.
Shared annual birthday parties with Barbara.
notable_stories: Would call Barbara Babs when he was mad at her or teasing her.
Did not actually guide Barbara on her first day of school after their mother told him to take care of her.
A speedy little fellow who frequently tormented Barbara by calling her Babs, which often resulted in her physically attacking him

education: Was at postgraduate school in Monterey while Barbara's family lived in Gilroy.

notes: Barbara was often compared to her brother Chuck academically.
